title: Italian Burger Buns
description: A classic Italian twist on the traditional burger bun, made with a light and airy texture.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, warm water, salt, sugar, and Italian seasoning.
2. Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal parts.
7. Roll each part into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk.
8. Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving space between each bun.
9. Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with Croatian bread crumb.
10. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
11. Let the buns cool on a wire rack before serving.
